name: Bio Plus Co., Ltd
summary: Based in Seongnam-si, South Korea, Bio Plus Co., Ltd, established in 2003, is dedicated to the investigation, formulation, production, and commercialization of bio-based items. The company’s diverse offerings include a variety of dermal fillers, such as SkinPlus – Hyal, Bio+ Dew, HyalDew, DeneB Classic, Stilea, and 3-Senses. Additionally, Bio Plus manufactures critical medical products: InterBlock, an absorbable anti-adhesion barrier; Synofil, utilized for synovial fluid replacement; and Blad-Care, a treatment for temporary alleviation of cystitis discomfort. Its mesotherapy portfolio features Kiara Reju for skin revitalization, Slim Slimmer for lipolysis, LumiDew for skin brightening, and JuveniHill for addressing wrinkles. The firm also supplies hair and scalp wellness products under the BelloHa and BellaChe names. Rounding out its extensive catalog are La Bella brand cosmetics, which include heparinoid essence, EGF balls, and specialized skin care gels.
